properties.description: Every presented data byte matches an already accepted input prefix or completion-justified zero padding, independently of output readiness.
Presented last markers delimit ordered frames clamped to 4..8 bytes, supporting streaming prefixes and an eight-byte output completing before its longer input.
Every presented header matches a completed accepted input frame with exact original length, adjusted length and flags. Header retirement is independent of data retirement.
Blocked data and header offers remain valid and stable until transfer or reset. Synchronous reset clears output valids and cancels epoch obligations without clearing historical alarms.
Meaningful unknowns, source validity during reset, blocked-source changes, accepted frames exceeding twelve bytes and bounded scoreboard exhaustion raise alarms rather than establish success.

The final-post marker enables completion checks combinationally without another edge: no partial input, outstanding response or remaining valid offer, and at least 32 ready-high reset-low idle edges. Final evaluation separately requires a 128-cycle tail; no public development/final selector exists.
